note: All events are unit-test fixtures. A hardware origin tag tests metadata propagation only and never establishes physical KeyLab validation.

tests.name: defaults expose documented software volume and native performance without fabricated encoder/fader CCs
MIDI Learn creates an exact device/channel-scoped assignment and applies range endpoints
same input replacement is predictable and old target stops changing
header Learn preserves a previously known exact source physical association
relearning a physical control removes its obsolete MIDI message
clear removes learned assignment and returns the physical control to unassigned
clearing a software volume default disables it until default restoration
fixed native performance entries cannot be removed by clear or reset
numeric, signed, enum and boolean parameter values use actual target domains
three relative encoder encodings use current UI values and clamp at target bounds
Learn without a selected physical identity never guesses an arbitrary encoder
note, pitchbend and program Learn extras do not suppress native performance paths
cancelled Learn leaves assignments intact and invalid target cannot arm
versioned MIDI configuration persists independently of patch data
export/import round-trip preserves mapping scope and clear-default configuration
reset-all clears learned controls persistently while restore-default remains available
unsupported import version is rejected without losing current assignments
invalid physical controls, duplicate imports and fabricated hardware status are rejected or normalised
malformed MIDI packets cannot change a mapping or create false activity
unassigned activity stays physically unidentified and synthetic origin is explicit
known assignment activity highlights its selected physical control without synthetic hardware claims
activity preserves an explicitly hardware-tagged packet without calling the unit test physical validation
blocked browser storage leaves a working in-memory registry with an explicit status
listener receives activity changes and unsubscribe stops notifications
device reconnection uses stable MIDI identity while a different device cannot claim it
